verdicts.reason: A and B look the same. In both, the 'Perfect Taste' script is tiny and still tilted, and it is centred over a dark, busy, blurred crop with poor contrast. The gold leaf wreath, which defines the brand look, has disappeared, and the figs are cut down to an unreadable sliver on the right. Neither one rearranges the design for a left-to-right banner.
